known_supplementary_items: Table S1 camera operation days SD-card changes and battery changes
Figure S1 site versus meteorological-office temperature relationship

CREMV3-007.methods_fact: sensor cameras were deployed before anthesis to flower senescence; scheduled cameras were used only in limited flowering-period trials until storage filled
CREMV3-007.author_stated_limitation: quantitative validation against continuous recording is necessary to fully test sensor-camera detection completeness
CREMV3-007.required_new_data: overlapping same-inflorescence continuous or prespecified scheduled gold-standard observation spanning the relevant flowering window, with effective-pollinator labels independent of fruit outcome and explicit camera-failure/out-of-frame accounting

BELV3-012.system: Belonocnema treatae / live-oak budbreak resource-dependency system
BELV3-012.metadata_fact: Budbreak in Nature estimates live-oak budbreak phenology and Emergence in Nature estimates adult B. treatae emergence phenology as distinct streams
BELV3-012.required_new_data: repeated within-tree budbreak/resource observations over the full relevant window with independent or cross-observer reference scoring, a prespecified usable-resource threshold, and explicit missing-record versus confirmed-absence coding

interpretation: The v5 calibration gap cannot be repaired from currently identified existing supplementary/raw sources. This closes the two retained candidates at an additional-measurement requirement rather than converting unavailable calibration into biological absence.
